BETA Close X Bellway PLC has announced the purchase of 248,500 ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange between April 20 and April 24, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The volume-weighted average price for these purchases was 1,988.46 pence per share, with prices ranging from 1,939.00 pence to 2,030.00 pence. These acquired shares will be cancelled, reducing the total number of ordinary shares in issue to 115,691,526. Disclaimer* Bellway PLC 27 April 2026 Bellway p.l.c. Transaction in Own Shares 27 April 2026 Bellway p.l.c. ('Bellway' or the 'Group') announces that, in accordance with the terms of the share buyback programme (the 'Buyback Programme') announced on 14 October 2025 and the terms of the Second Tranche announced on 2 April 2026, from 20 April 2026 up to and including 24 April 2026 the Group purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 12.5 pence each (the Ordinary Shares') through Deutsche Bank AG. Date Number of shares purchased Highest price paid (GBp) Lowest price paid (GBp) Volume weighted average price (GBp) Trading venue 20 April 2026 49,000 2,030.00 1,997.00 2,018.79 XLON 21 April 2026 49,500 2,020.00 1,972.00 2,004.57 XLON 22 April 2026 49,500 1,994.00 1,974.00 1,982.85 XLON 23 April 2026 50,000 1,997.00 1,966.00 1,982.08 XLON 24 April 2026 50,500 1,974.00 1,939.00 1,955.04 XLON The purchased Ordinary Shares will be cancelled. Since the announcement of the Second Tranche of the Buyback Programme on 2 April 2026, Bellway has purchased 641,279 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation. Bellway has now purchased 3,599,595 Ordinary Shares under the first and second tranche (to date) in aggregate for cancellation under the Buyback Programme. Following settlement of the above purchases and cancellation of the purchased ordinary shares, the Group's total number of ordinary shares in issue shall be 115,691,526 ordinary shares. In accordance with Article 5(1)(b) of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 as it applies in the UK (the Market Abuse Regulation), the table below contains detailed information of the individual trades made by Deutsche Bank AG on behalf of Bellway as part of the Buyback Programme.
